sloka: पाताLअस्याप्रमेयस्य द्वारमावृत्य तिष्ठसि ।तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव शक्तिस्ते शैल वर्धितुम् ॥५-१-९४॥
transliteration: pātāLasyāprameyasya dvāramāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi ।tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva śaktiste śaila vardhitum ॥5-1-94॥

translations.english: "O noble mountain you have the capacity to grow across, upward and downward by your free will. I therefore prompt you to grow.
